environment_hints: A simple cave, old village, ancient tool, ship, or historical object only when the narration supports it.
action_directions: One main stickman points toward a relevant historical place or object.
One main stickman recoils with raised arms at a surprising event.
One main stickman chooses between two relevant objects.
One main stickman examines a clue or artifact.
One main stickman runs, hides, or braces against a threat.
One main stickman gives a suspicious side-eye or smug shrug.
One main stickman moves through a cave, village, ship, or street.
One main stickman reacts to a consequence of the historical event.
clothing_hint: A muted tan tunic with a dark brown belt; black line details.
